# Which of your subcontractors is actually insured today?

> Free COI tracker for contractors and property managers: check subcontractor insurance against your contract's limits, endorsements and lead time, find expired and expiring policies and renewal gaps, and export a chase list and calendar. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/coi-expiry-gap-checker/)

- [PayApps](https://payapps.marisstella.app/?signup&from=coi-expiry-gap-checker): hosted pay-app billing for specialty subcontractors, open now and free on one job; paid plans are not on sale yet.
